name: Shared Tasks
description: Actions, deadlines, completion state, and native alert/checklist data. Uses an existing Collaboration space and its membership.
captureExamples: I need to call the dentist tomorrow.
notes: This is a concrete standard extension, generated from Tasks authoring source. Record payload schema identities are shared; membership comes only from the existing Collaboration space.
Use this variant when the user has selected a shared space. Standalone Tasks remains appropriate for independently shared roots. Do not write the same fact into both variants.

Admin and editor powers are explicitly declared per path. The owner controls space membership and subtree pruning. Personal root-level state is excluded from the shared subtree; keep it in the user's own module.

capture.identity: Select the existing Collaboration space first. Match the selected task record, project and intended action.
exclude: Writing the same fact to both the standalone and shared variant. A calendar appointment or habit check-in as the same task fact.
capture.workflow: Maintain actionable state and shared checklists; keep private reminders and pinning in owner-local state. Membership comes from the selected space; keep personal state outside the shared subtree.
